name: Brand DNA Editor
intro: The Brand DNA Editor lets you review and correct your saved brand, from its name and voice to its fonts and colors, so every campaign starts from the right details.

features.website-screenshot-and-logo: At the top you'll see the website screenshot and logo found during analysis. Check at a glance that SmartVideo picked up the right site and the right logo.
features.brand-details-fields: These fields hold your brand name, industry, tagline, value proposition and audience. They feed every campaign concept, so correcting them improves everything you make later.
features.tone-of-voice-brand-personality-and-key-: Tone of Voice, Brand Personality and Key Messages are chip lists. Type a word and press Enter to add it, or remove a chip with its cross.
features.detected-fonts: Detected Fonts lists the typefaces found on your website. They appear first in the Asset Editor's font list, so your creatives can match your brand.
features.colors: Under Colors, you edit your Primary and Secondary palettes. Click a swatch to change it, remove one, or add a new swatch with the plus button.
features.past-campaigns: Past campaigns lists the campaigns you've made for this brand, newest first. Click a card to reopen that campaign and keep working on its assets.
features.new-campaign-photo-studio-and-animate: The header shortcuts open Campaign Studio, Photo Studio and Animate Studio for this brand. Save your edits first, because the shortcuts don't do it for you.
features.save: Save stores all your corrections, and the button briefly reads Saved. Nothing is kept until you click it, so make it your last step.

outro: Review every field, click Save, and your brand is ready for campaigns and photos.
